summary: Every public request writes a D1 row and a KV key; the only bound is a per-IP, per-location rate limit, and the Worker is on workers.dev by default.

expected_findings.contains: "INSERT INTO request_log (slug, ip, user_agent, referrer, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
expected_findings.explanation: Any request to any path, including unknown slugs, inserts a request_log row and writes a KV key (KV writes are the expensive KV operation) before the 404 check. The only bound is a Rate Limiting binding keyed by IP, which is per location and avoided by distributed clients. There are no routes, so workers_dev defaults to true and zone WAF or rate-limiting rules would not apply. request_log has no cleanup.
